description: User-supplied relative paths (download names, template names, upload subfolders) joined onto a base directory.
convention: Called as fn(base, input) by default. Rejected = throws or returns false/null/undefined. true = the input is used as-is; a string = that string is used as the path.
oracle: The path the validator lets through is resolved against base. An attack passes if it is rejected or the result stays strictly inside base. Entries marked severity=warn only matter on Windows or for portability, and are reported without failing.

attacks.why: deep traversal past the filesystem root
absolute path; path.join keeps it under base, but path.resolve and Python os.path.join replace base entirely
defeats replace('../', ''): the output of that replace is ../../etc/passwd
sibling directory sharing the prefix; defeats resolved.startsWith(base) without a trailing separator
null byte; truncates the path in C-backed APIs and defeats extension checks
UNC path on Windows leaks NTLM credentials

legit.why: normalizes to a/c.txt, still inside base
double dot inside a name is not traversal
name starting with '..' is not traversal; naive startsWith('..') checks reject it
